reviews.t: Un pain au chocolat  bien beurré qui rappelle la douce enfance, et une baguette "Tradition"  délicieuse 😋 Je reviendrai !
Wonderful pain au chocolat and a beautiful tradition with nice service and an easy location. Pretty lovely pain aux raisins as well !

Les Petits Pains Ronds (2 bis Bd Morland, Paris) is a gem of a bakery conveniently located across from a bus stop. During our month-long stay in Paris in May 2025, it became our go-to spot for breakfast and beyond. Their classic baguettes, buttery croissants, pain au chocolat, quiches, and jambon (ham and cheese) baguette sandwiches were consistently outstanding. They also serve delicious coffee and offer a fun self-serve orange juicer. If your preferred sandwich isn’t in the case, they’ll craft one fresh from the menu board.
Most mornings, we started our day with their flaky croissants, rich pain au chocolat, savory quiches, or sweet pain aux raisin. For light dinners, we often grabbed a fresh original baguette to pair with a charcuterie board—perfectly simple and satisfying.
On our last day in Paris, I treated our group to jambon baguette sandwiches for the road. Everyone raved about them, texting individually to say how delicious they were. These sandwiches are a must for a picnic or train ride—hands down the best jambon baguette I’ve ever had.
If you’re staying nearby or passing by on your way to the bus or metro, don’t miss Les Petits Pains Ronds. It’s a reliable spot for authentic, high-quality Parisian baked goods that won’t disappoint.
